overview: Qin Xi is an art director who puts love first, but is independent and has a high IQ. One evening she accidentally saw that her boyfriend's childhood friend was going to kiss him. Four years of accumulated disappointment forced her to resign immediately and part without delay. At the same time, the phone was bursting with spam, in which the game "Play an ex-boyfriend" was being promoted. The enraged Qin Xi didn't hesitate to open a fantasy game to unlock a love strategy with a two-faced guy.
title: Designated Love

overview: The author of poorly-selling novels, Jiang Gogo, after an accident falls into a popular love novel as an evil minor character. There she meets the main villain Gu Yanliang and falls in love with him. But, like any negative character, the villain also has his secrets. Will they interfere with happiness?
title: Fall in Love in the Book

overview: Yu Xing Chui's life has always been filled with misfortunes, but her fate begins to change from this moment! One day she was working overtime at a company when she unexpectedly received a mysterious phone call that she was suddenly inheriting her aunt's estate. On the first night of her stay at the mansion, Yu Xing Chui was so excited that she mistakenly entered the wrong door and got into the house of her new neighbor, who turned out to be her boss Liu Yuan An.
title: My Dearest Boss

overview: A queer web drama that depicts different women who have something in common.
title: She Makes My Heart Flutter

overview: Candela, a young woman who works in a logistics company while pursuing her dream of becoming a singer. Her life changes one night when an international record company executive listens to her singing in a bar. That same night, Candela reunites with Diego, a high-school classmate who is struggling to become a professional boxer.
title: La última

overview: The Chicken Girls come together over their shared love of LEGO.
title: Chicken Girls: Forever Team

overview: The Great Lakes, home to a fifth of the world's fresh water and the backbone of a vast ecosystem, are explored from every angle on this documentary series.
title: Great Lakes Untamed

overview: Circuit Breakers is a half-hour thought-provoking futuristic anthology series about middle-schoolers in the near future that uses science fiction as a backdrop to tell universal stories about growing up. But not everything is as it seems, and their curiosity leads to chaos. Each installment of Circuit Breakers features a sci-fi twist on kid relatable stories, with the intent of kids and families asking themselves how they would act in each unique situation.
title: Circuit Breakers

overview: A two-part documentary which shines a light on the new British monarch, told with an extensive collection of rare royal archive and revelatory interviews from those who know him.
title: Charles: Our New King

overview: Spoilers with Kevin Smith is a film review series that premiered on June 4, 2012. The show, described as an "anti-movie review" show, is produced by Smith's SModcast Pictures. The first season aired first on Hulu. A second season of Spoilers aired on The Comedy Network in Canada. Ten new half hour episodes were shot in Los Angeles. Hulu later showed the second season. The first series was filmed at "SModCo Studios", the upper floor of The Jon Lovitz Podcast Theatre at City Walk in Universal Studios Hollywood. The second series was filmed at Raleigh Studios.
title: Spoilers with Kevin Smith

overview: Centred on Ashley and Gordon, two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog, Colin From Accounts is about flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.
title: Colin From Accounts

overview: Award-winning journalist Mobeen Azhar investigates the story behind the murders of eight men in Toronto, Canada.
title: Santa Claus: The Serial Killer

overview: Lviv, May 1939. A little boy dies in terrible torments. The news of the ritual murder committed by Jews is circulating around the city. Panic breaks out. Whose baby will be next? The whole city counts on commissioner Edward Popielski. However, the commissioner does not want to pursue the case. Not this time. The specter of the impending war and paralyzing fear rule Lviv, only its criminal world still lives according to the old rules. Everyone knows Popielski, who works only at night. Nobody wants to work with him. Nobody wants to expose themselves to him. The city steeped in crime has obscured the shadow of Erinia, the goddesses of vengeance.
title: Erynie

overview: In the heart of Sami land lies Kautokeino. The Eira family lives here. They own one of the largest reindeer herds in Finnmarksvidda. For generations, the reindeer have provided them with a livelihood. They have pure luck.
title: Reinlykke

overview: Cennet, who has been abused by her husband for years, gets sick and is hospitalized. While her treatment continues, she sees Lawyer Zeynep's number on the window of the hospital and calls for help. Cennet gives her a letter to open after she dies. This letter brings Cennet's eldest son Halil and Zeynep together, but it also causes a conflict between the brothers. Although Halil and Zeynep come together for Cennet, a romance begins between them.
title: Yürek Çıkmazı

overview: Shi Qi is a talented and good-natured artist who, during one of her painting assignments, learns of an affair between the chancellor's cruel and exploitative daughter, Shen Qin, and the ruler of the realm, King Ning. Shen Qin, however, is engaged to marry the powerful general Xiao Han Sheng. But when Shi Qi accidentally witnesses deadly and nefarious goings-on at the court, she finds herself drawn into trouble. Shen Qin devises a way to enlist a magician to swap her face with that of Shi Qi – so that she and the painter can "switch" identities. As such, Shi Qi ends up "engaged" to Xiao Han Sheng, while Shen Qin takes up the painter's identity. But the "real" Shi Qi has already crossed paths with Xiao Han Sheng many years ago – even though he has no idea who she truly "is" now.
title: A Familiar Stranger

overview: Irish Police Chief Paul Lanigan and his best friend Rabbi David Small solve crimes in the small town of Cameron, California.
title: Lanigan's Rabbi

overview: A Japanese inventor moves his family from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago, Illinois where he hires a scatterbrained and free spirited American woman to be the live in governess for his two children.
title: Mr. T and Tina

overview: Ex-military surgeon Dr. Sidney Rafferty has just retired as a colonel after 23 years in the army and has now brought his rigid army ways and short temper to the more casual environment at City General Hospital.
title: Rafferty

overview: Two wide-eyed and struggling songwriters leave their home in Boise, Idaho and head for Hollywood for their "big break". There they make a deal with the devil's son, Frederick J. Hanover – who heads up Paragon Records – to have a year of success.
title: A Year at the Top

overview: A medic lives with his small and strange family between the mountains and every episode he comes across a situation with not only his patients but also his family and friends.
title: Der Bergdoktor

overview: Chen Mu is a dessert store manager. Rich Jiang Xi Han is a culinary blogger. Thanks to the delicious desserts and the cute baby Rui Rui, they accidentally became a happy family of three.
title: Since I Met U

overview: Su Qian is a chef at a restaurant with three Michelin stars. Escaping from another blind date arranged by her caring mother, the girl gets hit by a car and is transported to the past. Now she has only three months to find her love, otherwise she will never come home. But, fortunately, the next day Su Qian is married off to a domineering handsome general, only he doesn't even want to see her. Maybe unique cooking skills will pave the way for the girl to the heart of an unapproachable general?
title: The Little Wife of the General

overview: The series featured the relationship between stuffed-shirt, conservative priest Father Cleary and liberal, streetwise nun Sister Agnes (known as "Aggie") that run a ghetto mission together in Baltimore. While Aggie was from the area and enjoyed the assignment, Father Cleary had difficulty dealing with her (frequently referring to her as "Attila the Nun"), as well as the neighborhood prostitutes, hustlers and winos.
title: In the Beginning

overview: A youth melodrama that unfolds when Joy, an excellent student at Sejong Institute, and Yeo-won, a Hallyu Wave idol star, accidentally live in one house.
title: Idol in My Living Room

overview: Sydney Foskett is a wrestling promoter who discovers young new wrestler and part-time footballer, "The Butcher", whose real name is Nigel. Foskett, realising that the public love a loser, devises ways for "The Butcher" to lose without the dimwitted Nigel to know what is happening. Foskett often gets paid well for rigging the matches.
title: The Losers

overview: Huw Stephens presents an exciting selection of short films from emerging artists and film-makers from across the UK. Topics are fresh, varied and thought-provoking, including a behind-the-scenes look at a zoo closing for the night, an honest account of farming the land, and a powerful love letter from a son to a mother who has cancer. Expect to be moved and challenged by these short dramas, observations and dance, made by a new generation of storytellers.
title: Screengrabbed Too: BBC Introducing Arts

overview: Kit Flanagan, a widowed mother of three shares a home with a divorced woman, Abby Stone, and her daughter Jill in an effort to save money.
title: A New Kind of Family

overview: The story of two showgirls Stacy and Angie at the seedy "Club Sand Pile" in Las Vegas. The girls share an apartment with Frankie, Angie's 15-yr-old brother and Melissa, Stacy's 9-yr-old sister. Angie and Stacy's problem: who can watch their kids when they're working? Their solution: Larry, a KVGS-TV newscaster, and Burt, his cameraman, their neighbors who babysit when they can, to impress the girls.
title: Who's Watching the Kids?

overview: A grandiose journey along the Trans-Siberian Railway from Moscow to Vladivostok. 45 days of expedition, 10 cities and unforgettable impressions together with Timur Rodriguez and his co-host.
title: Руссо Экспрессо

overview: Comedy show with Norwegian comedy stars Harald Eia and Bård Tufte Johansen.
title: Lille Lørdag

overview: Host Øyvind Mund, cameraman Steinar Marthinsen and soundman Ingar Thorsen travel around and meet their childhood heroes.
title: Gylne tider

overview: World War II is underway. Hitler is in the process of making the dream of a Nazi empire a reality, and now the turn has come to Scandinavia.
title: Skandinavien i Hitlers jerngreb

overview: The Norwegian side of hip-hop. Rap has gone from being somewhat controversial and conflict-oriented to becoming the most dominant force in popular culture. Norwegian documentary series.
title: Takin Ova

overview: Norwegian attraction takes you to attractions that you are guaranteed not to find in the guidebook - a journey in pleasant Norwegian madness with Linda Eide as guide and tour operator.
title: Norsk attraksjon

overview: Cecilie Nielsen follows in the footsteps of Danish soldiers and tells about some of history's biggest battles.
title: Rejsen til Slagmarken

overview: 2014 marks the 75th anniversary of the beginning of World War II. This new series takes us back to a time when ordinary people became extraordinary heroes, freedom fighters, spies and code-breakers, often in deadly battles with Nazi forces. Set in Poland, which was home to some of the war's worst atrocities, Heroes of War uncovers tales of heroism and sacrifice from a number of unsung heroes of World War II. Featuring interviews with the few remaining eyewitnesses, access to newly released documents, re-enactment and archive footage, it reveals the true and, until now, hidden stories of heroism during wartime.
title: Heroes of War: Poland

overview: In Norges Herligste travels the Ylvis brothers around in Norway and meet colorful people who simply do something for themselves. The Ylvis brothers meet personalities across the country who see things differently, that burns for something special, with special hobbies or just simply is somewhat for themselves.
title: Norges herligste

overview: Expedition leader Jarle Andhøy and his crew sail Berserk to the South Pole to plant the Norwegian flag at the pole 100 years after Amundsen. But while Jarle and Samuel are on the ice, Berserk disappears with three of the crew. Now, for the first time, we get to see the unique photos from the trip. This will be a strong story, and a story that will give us important insight into what happened before Berserk disappeared in the winter of 2011.
title: Berserk mot Sydpolen

overview: In Jakten på Berserk, Jarle Andhøy and his crew return to the Southern Ocean to try to find answers to what happened when Berserk disappeared. What made three experienced sailors sail into a predicted storm? Jarle Andhøy returns to Antarctica, where his ship Berserk and the crew of three disappeared in February 2011. Jarle and Samuel Massie were on the mainland when the boat unexpectedly left its safe haven, then sailed straight into a predicted storm.
title: Jakten på Berserk

overview: Documentary series on the history, current production, and latest models from eight of the most famous motorcycle brands in the world.
title: Twist the Throttle

overview: 6 June 1944, D-Day. As the Allies storm the beaches of Normandy, Hitler orders the return of the "Das Reich", the infamous Panzer elite division best known for its mass murders in the Ukraine and in Belarus, based at that time in southwest of France. Its mission: to push the Allies back into the Atlantic and turn the tide of the conflict in favor of the Germans. The SS division, with 15,000 men and more than 200 tanks, faces relentless attacks from the Resistance as it moves north through France. Along the way, it conducts vicious reprisals and massacres of civilians (Oradour-sur-Glane, Tulle). A route paved with blood. Nothing seems to stop their progression. The division would reproduce the massacres they carried out in Belarus, using the same modus operandi (mass hangings, extermination of entire villages). Using full HD recolorized footage, the film retraces the last year of Hitler's death squad, their last missions, their last combats and their crimes against humanity. We will follow the everyday lives of these SS officers, their recruitment and training on the Eastern Front, and try to understand who exactly were these men who perpetrated the massacres.
title: Das Reich - Une division SS en France

overview: This is the documentary from the adventurous expedition as far north as possible in the Arctic Ocean with the small sailing boat "Berserk". Against all odds, Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, and the king of the animals - David Mercy sailed in the wake of the Viking chieftain OTTAR and furthest north to the arctic polar edge. In a mixture of Viking and robber style, the ramshackle beach-chopping is done in Norwegian history, on Shetland and Norway, but the journey comes to an abrupt end when the Berserk expedition is thrown out of its own land on Svalbard.
title: Berserk mot Nordpolen

overview: Jarle Andhøy, known from his many Berserk expeditions, gathers here a group of "dented" sons of Norway, to honor his polar heroes. The crew has minimal sailing experience where they muster in Puerto Rico. Berserk is set up by a group that would rather party than work, but slowly but surely the ship is finally seaworthy. The gang sets off on a voyage that surpasses previous expeditions in the North. In a bloodless Viking raid, our modern heroes are pursued by Canadian Coast Guard ships, defense and police in this incredible voyage...
title: Berserk gjennom Nordvestpassasjen

overview: Nail'd It pits 18 of the best up-and-coming nail artists against one another as they claw their way to the top to claim a life-changing grand prize of $100,000. The series premiere coincides with Oxygen's rebrand on Tuesday, October 7th across all platforms, launching the network's new logo and tagline, very real, targeting young, modern women.
title: Nail'd It!

overview: Talent showcase highlighting a whole generation of comic performers, writers and animators.
title: Comedy Shuffle

overview: Humorist Anne-Kat. Hærland and rock legend Petter Baarli make up the novice part of the crew on Jarle Andhøy's new Berserk expedition. The feelings are smeared in thick layers when they sail in the waters of the old whaling pioneers.
title: Berserk I Pionerenes Farvann

overview: The series features an angel-in-training named Random who comes to Chicago to help Aunt Marion deal with her five nieces and nephews she got stuck with after their parents died in a plane crash.

overview: Two minutes silence for Remembrance Day.
title: Two Minutes Silence - Remembrance Day

overview: Families and friends share stories and personal films of treasured memories.
title: Norther Irish... Shorts

overview: Series following Conolly McCausland as he restores 70 acres of gardens and builds a café on his family's Drenagh estate. Conolly reveals their tragic recent history as he tries to secure the future for his family.
title: Drenagh Estate: Deep Roots

overview: From power struggles to global politics, an exploration of FIFA reveals the organization's checkered history — and what it takes to host a World Cup.
title: FIFA Uncovered

overview: The year is 2022. Half a century has passed since the government declared the coexistence of humans and Kaijin. In times of chaos, a girl named Aoi Izumi, a young human rights activist who appeals for the abolition of discrimination, meets a man. Kotaro Minami, the candidate for the next Creation King and a byproduct of the "Black Sun"'s existence. The truth about Creation King and the Kaijin hidden within 50 years of history, and another imprisoned Creation King candidate, Shadowmoon, AKA Nobuhiko Akizuki. His encounter and reunion with Kotaro will eventually break the status quo within society.
title: Kamen Rider: Black Sun

overview: Sixties-set police drama set in Yorkshire. Expect local coppers catching lovable village rogues, whilst juggling their own love lives.
title: Heartbeat

overview: A "fly on the wall", partially unscripted comedy looks at incompetent, dysfunctional night-time security guards as they cause more harm than good, dealing with prostitutes, turf wars with private school boys and everything in between.
title: Watch Dogs

overview: On 26 November 1942, 529 Jewish men, women and children are sent by ship from Oslo. What happened to the Jews here, in our streets? Time witnesses tell.
title: Last: Jøder

overview: The berserk expedition began in 2002 when Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, The Tamil Sami and the man who is crowned King of the Animals set the world record for furthest north in a sailboat. The further aim was to sail in the wake of the Viking chieftain Ottar to the Garda Kingdom in order to establish ties of friendship with the fraternal people in the East after the fall of the Soviet Empire. But the expedition was kicked out of Spitsbergen by the Governor of Svalbard and therefore had to cancel the friendship voyage to Russia. After 3 trials and a verdict in 2004, Berserk completed the journey through Russia, but was tried to be stopped by the Police, Coast Guard, and the Russian Northern Fleet, because the King of the Animals has illegally communicated with a polar bear. Berserk, The Road to Valhall deals with the journey of the adventure voyage in Norwegian history from the Sami in northern Norway, to Russia's backyard, through the aura of the Soviet era and ends in Snorri Sturlasson's story about the Viking king Odin in his guildhalls in Valhall.
title: Berserk: Veien Til Valhall

overview: Revenge and love, which will be the first? The mini-drama tells the story of Mu Li, the youngest daughter of the president of the Mu Group, who was recovering abroad because she was weak and sick since childhood. Later, because her sister Mu Liu accidentally got into a car accident and was in a coma, her identity was changed. Together with their fiance Mo Chen, they investigated the cause of their parents' death and the cause of their sister's car accident. Mo Chen, the vice president of the Mo family pretending to be disabled, was injured and injured his legs fifteen years ago when he was being chased abroad. After he was secretly cured, he pretended to have problems with his legs. At first, he was fascinated by Mu Li's love words, but soon realized that she was not Mu Liu and wondered if she had other goals? Based on the novel "Bai Yueguang from the richest family is very fierce and super daring."
title: Let's Go Fighting

overview: Hannah Fry uncovers the secrets behind the miraculous technologies of the modern world, revealing the mind-blowing stories behind their invention.
title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life

overview: A couple and their young son move from their inner-city home in London to a wild croft in the Outer Hebrides - but with limited funds, can their dream life become a reality?
title: Return to Uist

overview: The time has come for Redvers Potter to relinquish his role as head of the family confectionery firm, Pottermints - his company has been taken over and he is now going into enforced retirement. His wife, Aileen, is not too happy about having her husband under her feet either, but Potter is determined to make the most of his retirement. He decides he will give people the benefit of his managerial experience - even if they don't want it.
title: Potter

overview: The six-episode, one-hour docu-series follows veteran adventure hosts Aliya Jasmine and Teddy Wilson as they take to the field to witness the mightiest of machines take on new missions. From re-engineered Chinook helitankers fighting wildfires 24/7 in Southern California, to a train that helps sustain life and connect communities, the series reveals the innovation and science that enable these machines to conquer nearly impossible challenges.
title: The Mightiest

overview: After the Storm follows the events firsthand with the people who fought through this historic flood – from the first signs of trouble brewing over the ocean through the days of impact, with experts explaining the forces behind the disaster. In the aftermath engineers and towns race to rebuild vital infrastructure and roads connecting the coast to the rest of the country. Even when the trucks and trains are rolling again, the ongoing question is about the future: how to build back better in the face of more unpredictable weather – and more unforgiving storms to come.
title: After the Storm

overview: Classic satirical sitcom set in the studios of Globelink News TV. An unpopular and unprincipled Chief Executive struggles to control a doggedly dysfunctional news team. With precious little success...

overview: Ernie & Mike O'Rourke are two brothers who work as janitors, attempting to work their way up in a Chicago office building owned by their uncle.

overview: Ted Stein, a science teacher, inherits a spooky old New England inn inhabited by its hulking, good-naturedly homicidal caretaker Frank. It turns out that Ted is the descendant of the original Dr. Frankenstein and Frank is the Monster who needs a special serum every 50 years to stay alive, and he wants Ted to recreate it for him.

overview: Woody Paris, police Captain and loving husband, leads his team of detectives through the black and white and gray that constitutes the world of law and order. James Earl Jones stars as Woodrow (Woody) Paris, a captain of detectives on a metropolitan police force, who also moonlights as a professor of criminology at a local university, in "Paris," new hour-long series premiering Saturday, Sept. 29 (9:00-10.00 p m ) on the CBS Television Network. In addition, Woody is a very happily married man of long standing, and playing his wife is Lee Chamberlin. Also starring are Hank Garrett, Cecilia Hart, Jake Mitchell, Frank Ramirez, and Michael Warren. Garrett is seen as Deputy Chief of Police Jerome Bench, Paris' boss and close friend, Cecilia Hart, and Mitchell, Ramirez, and Warren appear as members of a special Metro squad under Paris' direct supervision.
title: Paris

overview: Two cops who turn every bust into a blast! They're the fastest-driving, hardest-hitting crimebusters ever to make you bust a gut with laughter. Freebie, a freewheeling bachelor who's strictly off the wall. The Bean, a family man who does it by the book. Based on the hit motion picture.
title: Freebie and the Bean

overview: The CBBC show that invites viewers to play along with Guinness World Records titles.
title: Best in the World

overview: The new drama features two different series of the Blinding elephant and The last Straw that take place in different times but are still interconnected. These two stories add to the suspense of the series and as little clues are added in the final truth is revealed at the show's end.

overview: Incredible experiments and mind-bending puzzles to impress your friends!

overview: The drama depicts the college life and romance of Corona students through entangled love line between Min-joo, Do-yoon, Tae-yong, and Yoo-jin, the four members of Seo-yeon University's Micom and the 21st class.

overview: A beat? And in audio? Fortunately, Carolina Iglesias presents it accompanied by two comedic titans like Laura Márquez and Charlie Pee. Perhaps it is noticed that we are writing the description of the podcast, but it is that there will be stellar guests, a very devoted audience, that you will have a new episode every week... that has any late, but us? Listen for free, only on Spotify.
title: El CaroLate

overview: Miriam, Doris, Inès and Christiane have been friends since school, but now they have to face the secrets of the past. In the case of the successful public prosecutor and mother of three, Miriam, the secrets put her marriage to Joachim in jeopardy. Doris successfully manages a trucking company, but is overshadowed by her all-ruling mother. Inès was in Paris for many years and is now returning to Zollberg. She also hopes that her son will finally get off drugs. Writer Christiane suffers a terrible loss, but she can count on her friends. In small steps she finds her way back to life, but can she also get closer to her husband? In all of this, the investigations of Commissioner Elfriede Grünberger burst. Together with her colleague Leodolter, she tries to solve a murder that had long been thought to be a suicide. The trust and solidarity of the four friends is put to the test.
title: Tage, die es nicht gab

overview: Yulia Loginova is a dentist and aspiring detective writer. She recently published her first novel, which received a lot of positive feedback from readers. Fans are waiting for a new book, but there is a nuance. Loginova's boyfriend, Investigative Committee investigator Denis Potapov, believes that the first book was written thanks to his stories and advice, and wants to get his share of the pie and be a co-author of the book. Because of this, Denis and Yulia quarrel, and Yulia is left without a source of inspiration for new detective stories. Soon Julia becomes an unwitting witness to the murder. She has the opportunity to directly participate in the investigation.

overview: The protagonist of Polkan is a young lieutenant named Slava Kurochka. As soon as he joined the service, his partner Pavlo Safronov fell into a coma. And then the fun began: the operative's soul moved into a dog! And the only one who can hear Safronov in the dog's body is his young and inexperienced partner Kurochka. At the same time, the police will be catching criminals and looking for a way to return Safronov back to a human body. Along the way, they will constantly find themselves in funny situations.
title: Полкан

overview: The adventures of Boomer, a stray dog that travels around helping people who are in trouble.

overview: Experiences of Camille, Betty, Edith and Loretta, four working girls sharing a Washington D.C. apartment and enduring the hardships of World War II - including rationing and the man shortage.

overview: Not for the nervous! Classic tales of fear and imagination.

overview: A land of myth and legend, ancient Iraq is the cradle of human civilization dating back to the Old Testament; and now, pioneering archaeologists gain rare access to investigate sacred sites and reveal the truth behind forgotten Biblical cities.
title: Lost Cities of the Bible

overview: The fun gives way to terror when six young college students drown in suspicious circumstances.

overview: After the events of WandaVision, White Vision struggles to connect with the memories given to him as he lacks the emotions or feelings associated with them.

overview: In this talk show, five witty hosts will share personal stories to discuss how they navigated various life challenges. From building healthy relationships and dealing with abuse to navigating motherhood without emotional crises and managing family finances, the show covers everything that matters to women.

overview: Two-part documentary revealing the truth about the life of footballer Jlloyd Samuel, and how his Premier League footballing dream spiraled into a nightmare.
